title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Restricted Persons
tiers.description: Employees who, due to seniority or role, are likely to come into possession of material information: Directors, MD, CFO, General Manager Engineering, Production Manager, Manager of PWR Europe, Manager of C&R Inc., Company Secretary, any person reporting directly to the MD or CFO, executive assistants to those persons, and their Closely Connected Persons. Subject to the closed periods, hedging/margin lending/secured financing restrictions, short-term and short-selling bans, and notification duty.

tiers.name: Directors and Employees
tiers.description: All Directors and Employees (full-time, part-time or casual) and their Closely Connected Persons, and Consultants. Bound by the general insider trading law prohibitions at all times but not by closed periods, clearance, hedging/margin lending or short-term trading restrictions unless also a Restricted Person.

rules.detail: Security includes derivatives, options and warrant contracts, and Trade includes granting, accepting, acquiring, disposing, exercising or discharging an option or other right or obligation to acquire or dispose of Securities, and agreements to do so. An OTC put/call over PWR shares is therefore a Trade, barred outside permitted trading periods unless clearance is obtained, and subject to the 3-day advance notice and post-trade confirmation duties.
rules.evidence: Security or Securities: Ordinary shares, preference shares, convertible notes, debentures, warrant contracts, options, derivatives, performance rights and other hedging instruments and mechanisms.

rules.section: Who is covered by this Policy?
rules.detail: Non-Restricted Persons are bound only by the insider trading law prohibitions at all times; no closed period, clearance or notification regime applies to them.
rules.evidence: Directors and Employees and their Closely Connected Persons and Consultants must comply with the insider trading laws; and Restricted Persons must also comply with additional trading restrictions.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on hedging (or margin lending or any other secured financing arrangement) that limits exposure to risk on unvested remuneration.
rules.evidence: You must not enter into margin lending, hedging or any other secured financing arrangement in relation to PWR Securities that would have the effect of limiting your exposure to risk in relation to part or all of your remuneration that has not vested, or has vested but remains subject to a restriction arrangement (eg a holding lock).

rules.detail: Same absolute ban expressly extends to remuneration that has vested but remains subject to a restriction arrangement such as a holding lock.
rules.evidence: or has vested but remains subject to a restriction arrangement (eg a holding lock).

rules.detail: Board approval required before entering a hedging arrangement over vested, unrestricted PWR Securities; material terms including the lender's right to sell unilaterally and trigger events must be disclosed to the Board, and the Company Secretary must be kept informed of relevant changes.
rules.evidence: You must obtain the Board's approval to enter into a margin lending, hedging or any other secured financing arrangement in relation to PWR Securities, providing the Board with the material terms of the proposed arrangements, including the right of the lender to sell unilaterally and trigger events.

rules.section: Definitions (Trade); What other restrictions are there?
rules.detail: Monetisation is not named. A prepaid forward or similar structure is a Trade (an agreement to dispose of Securities) requiring compliance with prohibited periods and notice, and if it involves granting security it is also a secured financing arrangement requiring prior Board approval.

(third parties) is the result of a third party fund or scheme investing in PWR Securities (but not exclusively) at the discretion of a third party (eg managed investment scheme or listed investment fund).

exemption_authority: Authorising Officer (MD/Company Secretary, Chairman, or the Board depending on applicant) may grant clearance to Trade during a prohibited period in exceptional circumstances (severe financial hardship, court order/legal obligation, or other circumstances the Authorising Officer determines exceptional), in their sole and final discretion without giving reasons; separately the Board may approve margin lending/hedging/secured financing arrangements.

bespoke_clauses.clause: (lender disposal) arises through the disposal of PWR Securities by a lender exercising their rights, except under a margin lending or other funding arrangement that is not permitted under this Policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A bank's enforcement sale on default is an excepted Trade even in a closed period, but only if the underlying secured financing arrangement was itself permitted under the Policy (i.e. Board-approved), so Board approval must be secured up front to preserve the lender's enforcement rights.

bespoke_clauses.topic: Board approval regime for secured financing
bespoke_clauses.clause: You must obtain the Board’s approval to enter into a margin lending, hedging or any other secured financing arrangement in relation to PWR Securities, providing the Board with the material terms of the proposed arrangements, including the right of the lender to sell unilaterally and trigger events.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unlike an outright ban, PWH allows a funded collar over vested unrestricted shares if the Board pre-approves the structure and is shown the loan's unilateral sale rights and trigger events, giving the bank a workable (if discretionary) approval pathway.

bespoke_clauses.clause: You must not enter into margin lending, hedging or any other secured financing arrangement in relation to PWR Securities that would have the effect of limiting your exposure to risk in relation to part or all of your remuneration that has not vested, or has vested but remains subject to a restriction arrangement (eg a holding lock).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar cannot be written over unvested equity or shares still under a plan holding lock; the bank must confirm vesting and lock release before structuring.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If you have entered into any margin lending arrangement, hedging or any other secured financing arrangement with the Board’s approval, you must keep the Company Secretary informed of any change in circumstances that may be relevant to PWR’s continuous disclosure obligations.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Re-margining, restructuring or early termination of the collar/loan must be reported to the Company Secretary throughout its life, not just at inception.

bespoke_clauses.clause: you are required to notify PWR of intended dealings in PWR Securities, by yourself or your Closely Connected Persons, at least three days prior to the intended Trading. ... Following completion of the proposed Trade, you must confirm to the Authorising Officer and the Company Secretary that the Trade has occurred, and details of the price per Security.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Entry, unwind or roll of the collar's derivative legs each need at least three business days' advance notice and post-trade confirmation of price and quantity, adding lead time to execution.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The Board may vary the prohibited periods from time to time by providing notice (written or electronic) to all Restricted Persons.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The Board can shorten open trading windows at will, adding timing risk to when the collar can be entered, unwound or rolled.

summary: A funded collar with a bank is achievable for Restricted Persons under PWR's policy, but only over vested, unrestricted PWR shares: the Policy expressly bans any margin lending, hedging or other secured financing arrangement that limits exposure to risk on remuneration that has not vested or remains subject to a restriction arrangement such as a holding lock. For vested unrestricted shares, both the loan leg (a secured financing arrangement) and the put/call legs (hedging) require prior written Board approval, with disclosure of the lender's unilateral sale rights and trigger events, plus ongoing disclosure of relevant changes to the Company Secretary. Execution must also sit within the general Trade regime: outside the closed periods (or with 5-business-day clearance from the Authorising Officer, granted or refused within 3 business days), preceded by 3 business days' notice of intended dealing, confirmed after completion, and not amount to short-term (sub-90-day) trading. If the arrangement is properly Board-approved, a lender's forced sale on default is an excepted Trade even in a closed period; if it was not permitted under the Policy, that exception is unavailable.
